build_QueryAndGroup_ball_query: build a point cloud grouping module using QueryAndGroup with ball query radius and sample number
build_QueryAndGroup_knn: build a point cloud grouping module using QueryAndGroup with kNN sampling by setting max_radius to None
create_GroupAll_forward: create a GroupAll module to group all xyz coordinates and features into a single group
run_grouping_operation: run grouping_operation to gather features by index from a batched tensor using CUDA extension
review_QueryAndGroup_uniform_sample: review QueryAndGroup forward pass with uniform_sample enabled to deduplicate and resample grouped points
